t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Selecting a gnome doesn't mean anything as points seem to be random.

vb_textbox.text: There seems to be no real strategy to this but some coloured gnomes do appear to give more mushrooms than others, for example, yellow gnome, red gnome, blue gnome. The gnomes with the tall hats seem to give less mushrooms overall than the gnomes with the short hats.
